title: The Markdown renderer cannot render nodes that plugins add
body:
Bugs seen in mistune: (1) create_markdown(renderer=MarkdownRenderer(), plugins=['task_lists']) fails with an AttributeError on 'list_item' for '- [x] a task' instead of returning '- [x] a task
'; a MarkdownRenderer subclass that defines task_list_item must have it used. (2) With the table plugin, MarkdownRenderer cannot render a table: '| A | B |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |
' must give '| A | B |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 2 |
'. (3) Rendering a standalone list_item token (type 'list_item' with a paragraph child) through render_token with a BlockState fails; it should give '- x

'. The RST renderer has the same gap for the list item and table nodes.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=src mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q tests
